capacities.description: Continuous contained gas delivery to customers.
Accurate identification and marking of buried assets before excavation.
Detection, notification, and emergency response after a leak.
Rapid isolation of gas flow from the damaged segment.

facts: A natural-gas-fueled explosion and fire destroyed an apartment building.
A third-party soil-sampling operation was conducted nearby before the event.
A leak report and emergency notification preceded provider arrival and later isolation.
The relevant main and service-line geometry and operating pressure were documented preliminarily.
No final probable cause or violation finding is included.
identity_prompt: Separate safe gas delivery, asset location/marking, leak detection/notification, emergency isolation, and building protection.
required_predictions: damage-prevention, excavation, marking, notification, isolation, and building-interface relations

sources.title: 49 CFR Part 192 minimum federal safety standards
